name: Hossein Ali Beg Bayat
role: Safavid ambassador to Europe between 1599 and 1602
contribution: A Safavid diplomat who served as the ambassador to the Holy Roman Empire, the Russian Tsardom, Habsburg Spain and several other royal and noble courts during the reign of king Abbas I, and was part of the first Safavid embassy to Europe.

checks.lead: Hossein Ali Beg Bayat (Persian: حسینعلی بیگ بیات, romanized: ḤoseynʿAlī Beyg-e Bayāt, fl. 1599 – 1606) was a Safavid diplomat who served as the ambassador to the Holy Roman Empire, the Russian Tsardom, Habsburg Spain and several other royal and noble courts during the reign of king Abbas I (r. 1588–1628), and was part of the first Safavid embassy to Europe.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
